integrity: A full symbolic proof is given; the included finite verifiers are auxiliary and their outputs are recorded without implying a formal proof checker. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to binary fixed weight two and the multiset of all linear contiguous length-k factors; no uniqueness is asserted for unknown weight, cyclic reads, set-only observations, or noisy/missing reads. Historical priority beyond inspected literature is not certified.
title: A sharp two-thirds reconstruction threshold and the unique long-read ambiguity fiber of binary two-marker words
